name: chapter-title
title: Chapter Title
description: A chapter title page used as a section header: a big number in the SFX face with a small label above it, the title in lettering (a real heading, read as "Chapter 3: title"), a 3px ink rule and an optional subtitle, and an optional column of vertical text at the end side against a narrow band of speed lines on its edge (never under the letters). Paper or ink. animated: the number pops and the rule grows from the start in steps when it appears; still with reduced motion.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/chapter-title". Pass titleId and point the section's aria-labelledby at it. The number and label are hidden from screen readers and repeated inside the heading.

meta.tagline: A chapter page that opens a section.
meta.usage:
import { ChapterTitle } from "@/components/manga/chapter-title"

<section aria-labelledby="ch3">
  <ChapterTitle titleId="ch3" number="03" title="The first panel" vertical="第三話" />
  …
</section>

props.name: vertical
props.description: A short column of vertical text at the end side.

props.name: animated
props.description: Number pops, rule grows when it appears.
